{!Contact.FirstName},
EXAMPLE: prospective student page Thank you for your interest in the graduate certificate in institutional research and policy analysis at ASU’s Mary Lou Fulton Teachers College. This program will enable you to analyze and present relevant data to improve student achievement and make informed decisions about your classrooms, schools and districts. Our students engage in data-driven decision making and are empowered to critically assess education programs and policies. We encourage students to use data from their own districts in their coursework to ensure that assignments are meaningful and germane. My name is Donna Parris and I am here to answer any questions you have about the program and to assist you during the application process. To get the most up-to-date program information, attend one of our upcoming information sessions. We offer both on-campus and online sessions for your convenience, some of which include faculty participation. Register now to reserve your spot for an information session as soon as possible. Please also take a look at the program guide for specifics on program requirements, the application process and funding information. My primary goal is to provide you with the support and resources you will need in pursuing your graduate education. Here are a few more links I think will be helpful for you: Mary Lou Fulton Teachers College Programs: How to Apply
